nodes.long_description:
# Grand Cinema Pro — Your Personal VR Cinema

Transform your Meta Quest into a private cinema with giant screens, immersive environments, customizable rooms, 360° media, music visualizers, and wireless streaming.

**Large IMMERSIVE ENVIRONMENTS**

Enjoy traditional theaters, a Snow Cabin, Underwater Reef, moonlit beach, and more. Choose your seat, adjust screen size, curvature, and brightness, or enjoy a floating screen.

**PERSONALIZE YOUR CINEMA**

Place your own photos anywhere in the room. Move, resize, and rotate images, including transparent PNG decorations, to create your perfect movie-night atmosphere.

**VIDEO & 360° PLAYBACK**

Watch flat, 3D, 180°, and 360° videos with subtitle support and automatic refresh-rate matching. View photos and explore immersive 360° panoramas.

**LOCAL PLAYBACK, STREAMING & CASTING**

Play videos and music from your Quest or stream from a PC or NAS using SMB and DLNA. Cast compatible media from your phone with available audio and subtitle selection.

**AUDIO-REACTIVE MUSIC VISUALIZERS**

Enjoy your music with colorful visual effects that react to the rhythm and bring your virtual surroundings to life.

**WEB CINEMA & PC CONNECT**

Watch YouTube and browse websites inside your cinema. Stream your Windows desktop and audio over Wi-Fi or USB using experimental PC Connect. Requires the free Grand Cinema Pro Windows companion app.

**YOUR CINEMA. YOUR RULES.**

Watch movies, listen to music, explore 360° photos, or create a spooky horror room
nodes.short_description: Your private cinema on Quest. Watch movies, play music, browse photos, and turn a 360° panorama into the room around you.

nodes.long_description:
Watch your own videos, websites and your Windows desktop on a giant screen in 21 authored cinema rooms or a floating-screen void.

LOCAL VIDEO: play flat, 3D, 180° and 360° videos from your headset or your home network (SMB/DLNA), with subtitles and automatic refresh-rate matching for smooth motion.

WEB CINEMA: open YouTube or any website on the big screen, with a built-in pop-up blocker and the Quest keyboard.

PC CONNECT (experimental): stream your Windows desktop and its audio over a USB cable or your local Wi-Fi at a steady 60 fps, with full 4:4:4 colour for sharp text. Requires the free Grand Cinema Pro app for Windows from the Microsoft Store. Pair once with a four-digit code; no account, no cloud and no tracking.

Make it yours: pick any seat, adjust brightness and screen curvature, let room lights react to the picture, and turn on a music visualiser that reacts to sound.

Film clips: Spring and Sintel © Blender Foundation | blender.org, licensed under CC BY.

nodes.change_log:
Grand Cinema Pro 0.5.0 for Meta Quest 3 and 3S

3D Blu-ray and local playback
- Play unencrypted 2D and 3D MVC Blu-ray ISO images and BDMV folders directly from local storage, USB, PC Files, or network servers. Includes chapters, PGS subtitles, and read-ahead buffering.
- Play MKV, MP4, and AVI, with HEVC/H.265, AV1, HDR10, PCM, and multichannel audio support. Automatically detect side-by-side and top-bottom 3D and 180°/360° VR video. Adjust picture sharpness and color warmth.
- Browse, search, save favorites, and resume playback. Supports FAT32, exFAT, and NTFS USB drives, including files over 4 GB on exFAT and NTFS.

Room Speakers and spatial audio
- Place and drag virtual cinema speakers around the room or use Lock to Screen. Configure speaker layouts for both local video and Web Cinema.

Subtitles, books, and Screenplay Sync
- Tap a subtitle word with your hand or controller to look up its meaning in Subtitle Explorer. Use dual subtitles, automatic character encoding detection, and SRT, ASS, VTT, or PGS tracks.
- Open a movie's PDF screenplay alongside playback and follow it scene by scene and line by line.
- Read PDF, EPUB, CBZ comics and manga, TXT, and Markdown. Highlight, take notes, and look up words in the reader or Mini Browser.

Cinema rooms, photos, and music
- Choose from 27 cinema rooms, including Void, indoor theaters, outdoor settings, and an underwater reef. Use Passthrough or your own 360° photo as an environment.
- Enjoy screen lighting, rain, thunder, snow, and swimming fish in the reef. Choose a seat, move or teleport, and recenter as needed. Room orientation is retained when switching rooms.
- View HEIC photos, panoramas, and 360° photos. Spatial 3D Photos adds depth to flat photos. The music player includes interactive room visualizers.

Web Cinema, PC Connect, and network playback
- Browse on the cinema screen or use the floating, multi-tab Mini Browser with Show in Mini. YouTube supports thumbstick seeking, 5- and 15-second skips, 3D detection, and fullscreen playback.
- Open and resume saved video links. Use Grand Cinema Pro as an external player with compatible apps.
- Stream a Windows desktop or game with the free Microsoft Store PC Connect companion and use a mouse and keyboard. Browse videos, Blu-ray images, photos, and PDFs with PC Files.
- Connect to SMB/NAS, FTP/FTPS, WebDAV, DLNA, Plex, and Jellyfin. Choose a start folder, browse up to 5,000 items per folder, or wake a sleeping NAS. Play M3U Live TV playlists or cast from your phone via DLNA.

Controls and performance
- Move and resize the floating tablet menu, then double-tap Menu to bring it back in front of you. Use improved hand tracking or either controller on its own, with trigger-drag seeking and thumbstick controls.
- Watch lying down or use a floating Passthrough screen. This release also improves YouTube startup, library scrolling, and PC/network subtitle scanning.

- Clock, date and headset battery (with charging indicator) on the control tablet.
- Network videos (SMB, NAS, media servers): MP4s that stopped with "file ended before its picture details were found" now play; smoother playback after skipping to the middle; real file names instead of codes in lists and Continue watching.
- USB drives: NTFS drives no longer stop with "Drive is in use" after declining Quest's format prompt.
- PC Connect: connects automatically when you open it and when you switch between USB and Wi-Fi; "Forget this PC" works on every tab.
- Seek bar: calmer look at the bottom of the picture, never covers subtitles; also shown for thumbstick skips with the menu open; skips use your skip-length setting everywhere.
- Faster, smoother rooms, menus, library, surround audio and streaming (many performance improvements).

Streaming apps: steadier playback when another app opens a video in Grand Cinema Pro, automatic reconnect, and Play always resumes.
Videos opened from other apps now show their poster and appear in Continue watching; expired links are clearly marked with a one-tap button to reopen the source app.
Web links: videos you play from other apps are saved with posters, resume exactly where you stopped, and refresh their link automatically when possible. Find them under Show > Web links and in Continue watching.
PC Connect: wake your PC from the headset, sync the clipboard, send files to your PC, and clear re-pairing when a PC removes the headset.

- Plex: sign in with a code at plex.tv/link and play your Plex movies with posters and story.
- New look for your movies: posters, ratings, story, quality badges and a Continue watching row. Movie info also from Kodi .nfo files and (optional) Wikipedia.
- Works with headset tracking turned off, for watching in a completely dark room.
- Back to your Stremio movie in seconds after watching something else, with its title shown.
- Wider playback timeline and an easy Back button on movie pages.
- Many stability, streaming and security fixes (Cast/DLNA, SMB, WebDAV, Private Vault, PC Connect).

- Fixed a crash during long 4K streams from stream apps (Stremio, Nuvio and others).
- Smoother streaming: videos from stream apps, links and your media servers (DLNA, SMB, Plex, Jellyfin and more) download minutes ahead to headset storage, so 4K plays with fewer pauses and skipping back is instant. Uses up to 4 GB temporarily, cleared when you stop.
- Open-air rooms: the screen now stands on the ground and wide films no longer float. Indoor theatres get a Screen size slider up to the room's wall.
- Hand controls: move the menu with the bottom bar, or pinch a side handle to hold it like a tablet. Menu size is remembered near and far.
- Picture & Sharpness: Meta Quest Super Resolution and Sharpening are at the top of Picture controls, work evenly across the picture, and can be switched on from Web Cinema too.
- Your own 360° photo: separate brightness for the room and the 360° surroundings, plus a one-tap Match button.
- Works with headset tracking turned off, for watching in a completely dark room.
- Files: new sort options (Smallest, Oldest, Longest, Shortest).
- Fixed: the last subtitle line of a paused movie could stay on screen during PC Connect or Web Cinema.
